newsitem.title: USA: Anvil Holdings unit issues $130 mln 144A notes.
newsitem.headline: Anvil Holdings unit issues $130 mln 144A notes.

text.p: The following debt issue from Anvil Knitwear Inc, a unit of Anvil Holdings Inc, was priced in the 144A private placement market on Tuesday, according to lead manager Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette.
Anvil competes in imprinted activewear segment of the casual apparel market.
TYPE SNR NOTES ISS PRICE 100.00 FIRST PAY DATE 9/15/97
LAST MOODY'S B3 YIELD 10.875 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
